position_rule: equal-weight midpoint of matched camera estimates
unmatched_rule: preserve a single-camera candidate at the registered 0.90 m radius
selection_rule: one-to-one greedy matching by smallest ground distance, then preserve unmatched candidates
comparison_rule: Compare with the strongest camera/method at the same inspection-area and false-alert budgets; prioritize recall, then false alerts, then localization error.
